Sam: Proposal: introduce a 'nonuniform lowbit lane' profile. per-operator bitwidths (e.g. fp8 for attn, int8 for ffn, 4-bit for embeddings) selectable by a precision profile. aim: cut token cost while staying within endpoint acceptability. Thoughts? :thinking:
Priya: sounds promising. two concerns: how to define/measure 'acceptability' and how to automate regression checks.
Marta: runtime constraints: profiles must be compact, versioned, and loaded at model startup. no per-request lookups. need clear fallback order (e.g. fp8->int8->fp32).
Jon: ops perspective: telemetry + quick rollback are critical. must have per-customer toggles and cost accounting by lane.
Priya: metric suggestions: deg-score per-response, perp delta, and business signals. compute deg-score server-side and emit traces. nightly golden-eval for each profile.
Marta: sketch of profile schema (small, versioned JSON blob):
```
{"profile_id":"nu-lane-v1","model":"redwood-m4","op_bits":{"attn_qkv":"fp8","ffn":"int8","emb":"4bit"},"fallback":["fp8","int8","fp32"],"acceptability":"deg:0.04,perp:1.1"}
```
Marta: runtime compiles per-op kernels and builds dispatch table; profile includes operator mapping version to avoid kernel mismatch.
Sam: API options: 1) customer selects named profile in endpoint config; 2) auto-mode where runtime picks cheapest profile meeting internal acceptability targets.
Jon: rollout plan: canary -> shadow -> gradual ramp. emergency kill flips endpoints to safe profile. also need alerting when deg-score drift exceeds threshold.
Priya: experiment plan: pick 3 endpoints, 2-week shadow. sample 1% responses for golden compare, compute per-endpoint quality and cost deltas; rollback if thresholds hit.
Marta: compatibility note: kv-cache snapshots and quantized weights must be compatible across profile versions; include a compat hash in metadata. cap profile blob size (suggest 8KB) and sign blobs for Private deployments.
Jon: deploy-bot: queued canary for branch "nonuniform-quant-lanes".
deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: build #4821 -> env=canary -> branch=nonuniform-quant-lanes. Logs: /builds/#4821.
Sam: I'll draft RFC covering schema, runtime load, fallback semantics, telemetry, rollout playbook, and console UX. tagging @Priya @Marta @Jon for review.
Priya: prepping deg-score instrumentation PR today.
Marta: prototyping profile loader and dispatch table mock.
Jon: ops will author alerting + kill-switch playbook.
Sam: meeting-free sync for now. ping me if you want a whiteboard session. :coffee:
